role: Data Analyst Intern — ShopNow India (Simulated Analytics Internship)
intro: A body of work you can defend in any data interview: a messy production dataset you audited, reconciled, and turned into an investor-grade data room.

resumeBullets.text: Audited an 18K-customer / 50K-order e-commerce dataset, detecting and remediating duplicate keys, null-driven join failures, and inconsistent categorical data using SQL window and aggregate functions.
Built return-adjusted revenue and margin models across 8 categories and 12 quarters, reconciling order and payment tables to surface rupee-level discrepancies.
Exposed revenue silently hidden by naive INNER JOINs and reconciled orders-to-payments to the rupee, quantifying orphan payments and uncollected revenue.
Segmented customers into LTV tiers and quantified revenue concentration, identifying over-performers and a ranked win-back list.
Developed monthly cohort retention and MoM growth analyses with window functions (ROW_NUMBER, LAG, running aggregates) to quantify churn and trajectory.
Cleaned a 120K-row raw clickstream (dedup, normalization) and built a 4-stage purchase funnel with per-step conversion, in a single analytical SQL query.
Delivered a documented, re-runnable investor data room answering a PE firm's due-diligence checklist, with methodology and edge-case handling.

Designed a star-schema gold layer (fact + conformed dimensions + a generated date dimension) with validated referential integrity, and built a multi-page Power BI dashboard with DAX measures and time intelligence (MoM, YTD, ROAS).

note: Bullets unlock as you complete the work that earns them. A bullet you haven't earned yet is shown greyed out — no inflating the résumé.
